correctness.rationale: The definition is the degree-at-most-two edge-subset complex, equivalently avoidance of the 8 forbidden three-edge stars in the cube. Independent enumeration of all 4095 nonempty masks recovers exactly 1698 faces with dimensions counts (12,66,212,423,516,352,108,9), and 7980 Hasse incidences. The prescribed descending-pivot matching gives 847 disjoint pairs, one critical vertex and three critical 5-cells; a complete 1698-vertex topological sort of the reversed Hasse graph verifies acyclicity. A Forman CW model thus has only a point and three 5-cells and is exactly a wedge of three S^5, not a homology-only guess. Independent exact signed reduced Lefschetz summation for all 48 signed cube actions matches the S4×C2 character (-1)^t sgn(pi)(Fix(pi)-1); sign-twisted S4 standard is irreducible and inversion odd. The attached verifier source was inspected; the finite enumeration here IS an exhaustive certificate for the finite object.
